prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return Solution.java defining public final class Solution.
Required API: public static String eventDeduplication(String input)
Behavior: Parse window;timestamp:key records. Window and timestamps are canonical unsigned decimals in 0..10000000, records are nondecreasing by timestamp, and keys use ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. Keep an event only when that key has no previously kept event within the inclusive window. Return kept timestamp:key records in input order.
Visible example: 5;1:a,3:b,5:a,7:a returns 1:a,3:b,7:a.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static String eventDeduplication(String s){try{String[]p=s.split(";",-1);if(p.length!=2||p[1].isEmpty()||!p[0].matches("0|[1-9][0-9]*"))return null;long w=Long.parseLong(p[0]),prev=-1;if(w>10000000)return null;var last=new HashMap<String,Long>();var o=new ArrayList<String>();for(String r:p[1].split(",",-1)){String[]q=r.split(":",-1);if(q.length!=2||!q[0].matches("0|[1-9][0-9]*")||!q[1].matches("[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*"))return null;long t=Long.parseLong(q[0]);if(t>10000000||t<prev)return null;prev=t;if(!last.containsKey(q[1])||t-last.get(q[1])>w){last.put(q[1],t);o.add(r);}}return String.join(",",o);}catch(Exception e){return null;}}}
